evidence: Labeled Utils/log/libs and introduces the AssertUnreachable() macro in src/util/check.h.
rationale: The PR introduces AssertUnreachable() in util/check.h to provide a clean abort helper with noreturn semantics for unreachable code paths. It addresses compiler warnings under clang-cl and GCC -Wreturn-type while eliminating ambiguity surrounding NDEBUG and undefined behavior.
